Every child deserves a safe childhood — a chance to learn, play, and grow without fear. The Protection of Child Rights Act and related laws aim to ensure every child in India grows up safe and educated. However, in 2025–2026 many children still face abuse, neglect, and exploitation despite legal safeguards.

What is the Protection of Child Rights Act in India?
The Protection of Child Rights Act 2005, also known as the Commission for Protection of Child Rights Act 2005, led to the establishment of the National and State Commissions for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR and SCPCRs) frameworks, which monitor and safeguard child rights. Together with laws like POCSO and the Juvenile Justice Act, it protects children from abuse, labour, and discrimination.

Education is crucial for child development, yet a significant divide exists between urban and rural areas in India. Urban children benefit from superior infrastructure and resources, while rural counterparts often lack access to quality education. Digital classrooms are emerging as a transformative solution to bridge this gap, providing equal learning opportunities through technology. They incorporate various digital tools for more engaging and effective teaching, benefiting students by enhancing their understanding and motivation. However, challenges such as poor connectivity and limited resources hinder implementation. Summer Camp Day 2 🎨🖌️
Today’s creative session was filled with imagination, colours, and creativity! The children explored art and craft by making beautiful 3D art, flower vases, and Warli paper creations using simple craft materials.

Every activity encouraged innovation, hands-on learning, and self-expression while helping the students turn their artistic ideas into something truly special.

Summer Camp Day 1 kicked off with energy, laughter, and endless fun✨
From obstacle races and cup stack relays to dodgeball and mind games, our little champions gave it their all while learning confidence, coordination, and the true spirit of teamwork.

Every piece of waste thrown carelessly begins with a thought “it’s too small to matter.”
But environmental damage is built exactly like that: one habit, one bottle, one ignored action at a time.

Awareness is not just about knowing better. It’s about choosing better, even in the smallest everyday moments. Because the planet does not need occasional heroes it needs consistent responsibility. 🌍

Together, through conversations, reflection, and action, we move one step closer towards a cleaner and more conscious future.

Special thanks to Wood Mackenzie and Muskurate Raho for supporting and making this awareness initiative possible. 💚

Our cities are home to more than just humans. 🐾
Every street, tree, and corner is also shared by animals who feel fear, comfort, hunger, and safety just like we do. Through this thoughtful session on Animal Welfare, Human-Animal Conflict, and Urban Design, children explored empathy, emotional literacy, and awareness towards the animals around them.

A heartfelt thank you to Rihaan Sodhani for conducting such an engaging and meaningful session, and to TribesforGood for making these important conversations possible. 🌿✨

Because coexistence begins when we stop seeing animals as “strays” and start recognising them as sentient neighbours who belong here too.

Little voices, powerful thoughts 🌱

Through Eco Expression, our children shared their ideas, concerns, and hopes for the environment through creativity, conversations, and imagination. It was truly inspiring to witness how aware and thoughtful young minds can be when given the space to express themselves. Their reflections reminded us that creating a sustainable future begins by nurturing awareness, empathy, and responsibility from an early age.

A heartfelt thank you to ConnectFor for supporting and encouraging meaningful experiences that help children become conscious and compassionate changemakers for tomorrow. 💚

Sometimes, the smallest hands create the biggest impact 🌍
The paper bags made by our children were lovingly distributed within the community, carrying not just creativity, but also a message of care for our environment. Through this initiative, the children learned that simple everyday choices — like saying no to plastic — can help build a cleaner and greener future. Seeing them proudly share something they created with purpose was truly heartwarming.

Some conversations take time to begin but when they do, they open doors to understanding, dignity, and change. 💛

Because awareness is not just information it’s about unlearning, supporting one another, and knowing you’re not alone in your journey. 🌿

Every piece of waste thrown carelessly begins with a thought “it’s too small to matter.”
But environmental damage is built exactly like that: one habit, one bottle, one ignored action at a time.

Awareness is not just about knowing better. It’s about choosing better, even in the smallest everyday moments. Because the planet does not need occasional heroes it needs consistent responsibility. 🌍

Together, through conversations, reflection, and action, we move one step closer towards a cleaner and more conscious future.

Special thanks to Wood Mackenzie and Muskurate Raho for supporting and making this awareness initiative possible. 💚

Our cities are home to more than just humans. 🐾
Every street, tree, and corner is also shared by animals who feel fear, comfort, hunger, and safety just like we do. Through this thoughtful session on Animal Welfare, Human-Animal Conflict, and Urban Design, children explored empathy, emotional literacy, and awareness towards the animals around them.

A heartfelt thank you to Rihaan Sodhani for conducting such an engaging and meaningful session, and to TribesforGood for making these important conversations possible. 🌿✨

Because coexistence begins when we stop seeing animals as “strays” and start recognising them as sentient neighbours who belong here too.

Little voices, powerful thoughts 🌱

Through Eco Expression, our children shared their ideas, concerns, and hopes for the environment through creativity, conversations, and imagination. It was truly inspiring to witness how aware and thoughtful young minds can be when given the space to express themselves. Their reflections reminded us that creating a sustainable future begins by nurturing awareness, empathy, and responsibility from an early age.

A heartfelt thank you to ConnectFor for supporting and encouraging meaningful experiences that help children become conscious and compassionate changemakers for tomorrow. 💚

Sometimes, the smallest hands create the biggest impact 🌍
The paper bags made by our children were lovingly distributed within the community, carrying not just creativity, but also a message of care for our environment. Through this initiative, the children learned that simple everyday choices — like saying no to plastic — can help build a cleaner and greener future. Seeing them proudly share something they created with purpose was truly heartwarming.

Some conversations take time to begin but when they do, they open doors to understanding, dignity, and change. 💛

Because awareness is not just information it’s about unlearning, supporting one another, and knowing you’re not alone in your journey. 🌿

featured_reviews.review_text:
Looking back on my time with Umang Foundation Trust, I feel incredibly thankful for an experience that has deeply impacted me and expanded my perspective in countless ways.

Guided by the supportive mentorship of Ms. Mansi Rane, I spent valuable time at the Umang Learning Centre, engaging with children from underserved communities. Teaching subjects like English, Hindi, Math, Science, History, and General Knowledge to students of various age groups helped me grow both personally and professionally. Every classroom session was a blend of learning, creativity, and heartwarming interactions.

A standout highlight was participating in the ‘Back to School 2025’ initiative on 9th July. During our visit to Zilla Parishad School in Talawade, Shahapur, I had the chance to help distribute school supplies, conduct art-based learning activities, and take part in engaging classroom teaching. It was a day filled with smiles, color, and connection.

More than anything, what made this journey unforgettable were the bonds I formed—with the enthusiastic children, dedicated volunteers, and the ever-welcoming community. Their warmth, courage, and curiosity have left a lasting impression on me.

I extend my sincere thanks to Ms. Mansi and the entire Umang Foundation Trust family for welcoming me into their world and letting me contribute in a small yet meaningful way. This journey will forever hold a special place in my heart.
